preview_features: window open, focus, minimize, maximize, close and drag
window tiling and taskbar/dock window switcher
theme, display scale, high contrast and reduced-motion preferences
keyboard shortcuts and context-menu workspace access
native_adapter_required: real process launch and process supervision
real file-system mounts and file portals
multi-monitor enumeration, display modes, HDR and color management
network, Bluetooth, audio, camera and peripheral services
power, battery, sleep, lock screen and session lifecycle
real system notifications, focus rules and per-app permissions
package installation, signed updates, sandboxing and secure credential storage
clipboard, drag/drop, screen capture and global hotkeys
assistive technology APIs, complete localization and IME integration

acceptance.preview_test: node syntax check plus desktop contract regression tests
acceptance.native_acceptance: requires implementation, session-manager wiring, packaged artifacts and runtime evidence on each supported target
acceptance.policy: A browser preview or feature inventory must never be reported as a native desktop implementation.
